$comment: Triaged entropy ceiling for #544, corrected in #677, lowered in #676 and again in #703. Lower it when the count drops; never raise it to make CI pass. See docs/knowledge/decisions/0012-entropy-ratchet.md for the triage and the categories behind the number.
$correction: #677: the exclude list inherited from the CLI covered **/*.test.ts but not **/*.test.js, so all 32 node:test files under npm/scripts/__tests__/ were scanned as ordinary source and reported unreferenced. entropy.excludePatterns is now declared in harness.config.json and the measured count fell 340 -> 308, purely subtractive (the report is otherwise byte-identical).
$reduction: #676: 26 dead documentation links repaired (v6.0.0 Python retirement and the docs/adr -> docs/knowledge/decisions move). 21 of them fall inside docs/, the only tree `harness cleanup` scans, so the measured count fell 308 -> 287. This composes with #677 rather than overlapping it: #677 removed test files from the denominator, #676 removed dead links from the numerator. Re-measured on the merged tree, not derived arithmetically.
$paydown: #703: 15 provably-dead exports removed to create durable headroom (main measured 296 against the 297 ceiling — one finding, and two finished branches waiting on three). Every one was verified category-1 before touching: no importer of the declaring module references it, including via `dist` (the npm package's node:test suite requires `../../dist/*.js`, so npm/src exports that look dead are NOT) and via the ts/src -> npm/src `sync-gate-result.mjs` mirror (`skippedSuffix` looks dead in ts/src and is live in the generated copy). 13 are `export` keyword removals on symbols still used inside their own module — no code deleted, nothing changes at runtime. 2 are real deletions: the `scanFile` thin wrapper in the canary-savant and canary-blackhawk scanners, which had zero consumers anywhere (neither skill's cli.mjs nor its test imports it; both import `scanText`/`scanTextFull`/`scanPaths`). Measured 296 -> 281 on the real tree with `harness cleanup --findings-json`, and the before/after `--json` sets differ by exactly those 15 with ZERO additions and drift unchanged at 24 — purely subtractive, never derived arithmetically. Left deliberately: the 24 drift findings (upstream detector defects, re-verified fence-quoted), the ADR-triaged testkits / fixture projects / spike / five test-only ts/src modules, 15 npm/src exports covered via dist, and `ts/src/cli-common.ts::ensureAscii` — see the wiring finding in ADR 0012.
